column2: Cart after cart is hauled up from the mine in [gold_rush_province.GetName] and set before me. I try to count them and soon lose track. Every one is heaped with gold, raw and glittering, and every grain of it is mine. The miners swear they have never seen a vein this rich. Some of them are already whispering about what else might be sleeping down there in the dark.

The overseer of the mine in [gold_rush_province.GetName] comes up from the deep with his beard full of dust and his eyes shining. A new seam! Fat yellow gold running through the rock like veins through a forearm. Cart after cart rattles out of the shafts. My ancestors would weep to see it. Gold is the blood of the mountain and the mountain has opened her heart to me.

Just as I am about to retire for the day a messenger comes running up to me, quite out of breath. He bows quickly before speaking: "Forgive me, my [Root.GetLordLady], but... the gold mine has given out! The last vein in [depleted_gold_mine_target.GetName] is worked to nothing. The miners dig and dig and find only stone."
Word has come from [From.GetName]: the old gold mine is working again! Prospectors cutting a new gallery broke into a vein nobody knew was there, and the carts are already rolling.

The flood of gold out of the mine in [gold_inflation_province.GetName] has driven up prices across the province. Bread costs twice what it did, the merchants grow fat, and the peasants have less coin left over to pay me my taxes.
Such is the price of gold...
Clever investments should keep prices in check.
Have soldiers take the gold back by force!
